build_tactics: Fights the way it drilled: hold the line, strike the enemy in front of you, keep your shield up and your footing. No tricks, no gimmick -- just a professional doing soldier's work.

boons_detail.description: Your sphere abilities are more potent; for example, while your current spell points are at half your total or less you gain +1 caster level, rising to +2 at 0 spell points.
boons_detail.name: Empowered Abilities

boons_detail.description: (Counters Focus Casting) You no longer need to make a check to cast without your focus item, or you ignore part of the Focus Casting penalty; maintaining a sphere ability that needs a standard action to concentrate on requires only a move action.
boons_detail.name: Easy Focus

drawbacks_detail.description: Your casting is accompanied by an obvious tell-tale sign (glowing eyes, sound, smell, sigils) that reveals you are using magic and identifies you as the source.
drawbacks_detail.name: Magical Signs

drawbacks_detail.description: Spending a spell point forces a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 caster level) or you become sickened (then nauseated, then stunned on repeated failures).
drawbacks_detail.name: Painful Magic

drawbacks_detail.description: Your magic is addictive; each time you spend spell points you must make an escalating Fortitude save or risk gaining/intensifying an addiction, taking escalating penalties until you cast again.
drawbacks_detail.name: Addictive Casting

drawbacks_detail.description: Each time you spend a spell point you take a small amount of nonlethal damage (scaling with caster level) that can only be removed by rest, not by healing or DR.
drawbacks_detail.name: Draining Casting

Actions.10 E-Kats: hero point: Use as a Hero Point (you can store it if you have room).
Actions.2 E-Kats: bonus: Gain a +1 on ANY roll; +2 if declared before the roll.
Actions.2 E-Kats: penalty: Inflict a -1 on ANY roll; -2 if declared before the roll.
Actions.20 E-Kats: borrow a feat or spell: Gain the ability to use a feat or mythic spell you qualify for, excluding the mythic requirement. Feats last one minute; spells last for the duration of the spell.
Actions.25 E-Kats: Luck Trait: 25 permanent E-Kats can be used to purchase a Luck Trait.
Actions.5 E-Kats: stabilize: Stabilize ANYONE within five feet, provided they are not already beyond stabilization.
Actions.99 E-Kats: Destined Template: Gain the "Destined" Template (only once per player). This action locks your slot into a future campaign and ties it to this character.
Actions.99 E-Kats: survive anything: You may exchange 99 E-Kats to survive anything.
Actions.Active modifiers: Roll-based E-Kat bonuses are multiplied by 2 (Lucky Boy); permanent E-Kat acquisition is doubled (Double Down).
Actions.Hero point for 5 E-Kats: 1 non-temporary Hero Point can be exchanged for 5 E-Kats (not multiplied by Lucky Boy).

Actions (Purchased).Loot Box: Increase loot table roll by one category before the roll for 25 E-Kats.

Feats Not Taken (reference).Feat: Luck God: [+4 Luck] All E-Kat costs (excluding the 99 tier and purchasing new Luck Traits) are cut in half; you gain a +2 bonus to all saves, attacks, ability checks, skill checks, AC, and Caster Level Checks. You gain a +4 Luck, and once per day can force a reroll in your favor.
Feats Not Taken (reference).Feat: Middle Finger: [+1 Luck] Gain 1 E-Kat anytime the GM has a hostile NPC utilize a Hero Point.
Feats Not Taken (reference).Feat: Stream of Luck: [+1 Luck] Gain one E-Kat per session (character played), two if you have Double Down.
Feats Not Taken (reference).Feat: Sweet Dreams: [+1 Luck] Gain one E-Kat per in-game long rest, two if you have Double Down. (Applies once to timeskips longer than a day.)
Feats Not Taken (reference).Feat: Very Lucky Boy: [+1 Luck] E-Kat (roll based) bonuses are increased to triple.

Feats Taken.Feat: Ass Pull: [+4 Luck] Gain 4 E-Kats per session that expire upon the session's end, and a +4 Luck.
Feats Taken.Feat: It Just Works: [+4 Luck] Gain one free Hero Point per session that expires upon the session's end, +4 Luck.
Feats Taken.Feat: Lucky Boy: [+1 Luck] E-Kat (roll based) bonuses are doubled.
Feats Taken.Feat: Right of Deferment: [+1 Luck] You may wait to apply E-Kats after a roll for no penalty.

Reserve.Your reserve: 0 E-Kat(s) carried into play, of 25 earned at creation (1 spent on Luck Traits at 25 each). Storage cap 99.

Skill Unlock: Sense Motive.10 Ranks: After conversing for 1 minute, you can read a creature's surface thoughts at a -20 penalty opposed by its Bluff (as detect thoughts).
Skill Unlock: Sense Motive.15 Ranks: You can read surface thoughts after 1 round, and when attacked may attempt an immediate-action Sense Motive check to gain a +2 insight bonus to AC against that foe.
Skill Unlock: Sense Motive.20 Ranks: You can read surface thoughts as a standard action, and a successful insight-bonus check negates the triggering attack.
Skill Unlock: Sense Motive.5 Ranks: If aware of an opponent before initiative, you can attempt a Sense Motive check as part of initiative to gain a scaling initiative bonus.

adaptable training (ex).description: the fighter can use his base attack bonus in place of his ranks in one skill of his choice from the following list: acrobatics, climb, disguise, escape artist, intimidate, knowledge (engineering), profession (soldier), ride, or swim. The fighter need not be wearing armor or using a shield to use this option. When using adaptable training, the fighter substitutes his total base attack bonus (including his base attack bonus gained through levels in other classes) for his ranks in this skill, but adds the skills usual ability score modifier and any other bonuses or penalties that would modify that skill. Once a skill has been selected, it cannot be changed, and the fighter can immediately retrain all of his ranks in the selected skill at no additional cost in money or time. In addition, the fighter adds all skills chosen with this option to his list of class skills. A fighter can choose this option up to four times.

armored juggernaut (ex).description: when wearing heavy armor, the fighter gains dr 1/. At 7th level, the fighter gains dr 1/ when wearing medium armor, and dr 2/ when wearing heavy armor. At 11th level, the fighter gains dr 1/ when wearing light armor, dr 2/ when wearing medium armor, and dr 3/ when wearing heavy armor. If the fighter is 19th level and has the armor mastery class feature, these dr values increase by 5. The dr from this ability stacks with that provided by adamantine armor, but not with other forms of damage reduction. This damage reduction does not apply if the fighter is helpless, stunned, or unconscious.

quick donning (ex).description: the fighter can don armor in a hurry without reducing its effectiveness, and remove it quickly when it becomes a hindrance. When the fighter dons or removes his armor or dons it hastily, the amount of time needed to do so is reduced. The fighter can also remove sections of armor to escape grapples and similar hindrances. Whenever the fighter attempts a combat maneuver check, an escape artist check, or a strength check to escape from an effect that reduces or restricts his ability to move or act, he can reduce the armor bonus of any armor that he is wearing by up to half his armors base armor bonus. If he does so, he gains a bonus on his check equal to the amount by which he reduced his armors armor bonus. Multiple uses of this ability cannot reduce the armors armor bonus below half its base armor bonus, and the reduction to the armors armor bonus lasts until the fighter recovers and dons the removed pieces of armor.

effortless dual-wielding (ex).description: the fighter treats all one-handed weapons that belong to the associated weapon group as though they were light weapons when determining his penalties on attack rolls for fighting with two weapons.

weapon specialist (ex).description: the fighter selects a number of combat feats that he knows equal to his weapon training bonus with the associated weapon group. The selected feats must be ones that require the fighter to choose a type of weapon.

class_ability_desc.armor mastery: At 19th level, a fighter gains DR 5/- whenever he is wearing armor or using a shield.
class_ability_desc.armor training: Starting at 3rd level, a fighter learns to be more maneuverable while wearing armor. Whenever he is wearing armor, he reduces the armor check penalty by 1 (to a minimum of 0) and increases the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed by his armor by 1. Every four levels thereafter (7th, 11th, and 15th), these bonuses increase by +1 each time, to a maximum -4 reduction of the armor check penalty and a +4 increase of the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed. In addition, a fighter can also move at his normal speed while wearing medium armor. At 7th level, a fighter can move at his normal speed while wearing heavy armor.
class_ability_desc.bonus feats: At 1st level, and at every even level thereafter, a fighter gains a bonus feat in addition to those gained from normal advancement (meaning that the fighter gains a feat at every level). These bonus feats must be selected from those listed as combat feats, sometimes also called "fighter bonus feats."Upon reaching 4th level, and every four levels thereafter (8th, 12th, and so on), a fighter can choose to learn a new bonus feat in place of a bonus feat he has already learned. In effect, the fighter loses the bonus feat in exchange for the new one. The old feat cannot be one that was used as a prerequisite for another feat, prestige class, or other ability. A fighter can only change one feat at any given level and must choose whether or not to swap the feat at the time he gains a new bonus feat for the level.
class_ability_desc.bravery: Starting at 2nd level, a fighter gains a +1 bonus on Will saves against fear. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd.
class_ability_desc.weapon mastery: At 20th level, a fighter chooses one weapon, such as the longsword, greataxe, or longbow. Any attacks made with that weapon automatically confirm all critical threats and have their damage multiplier increased by 1 (×2 becomes ×3, for example). In addition, he cannot be disarmed while wielding a weapon of this type. Alternate Capstones
class_ability_desc.weapon training: Starting at 5th level, a fighter can select one group of weapons, as noted below. Whenever he attacks with a weapon from this group, he gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls. Every four levels thereafter (9th, 13th, and 17th), a fighter becomes further trained in another group of weapons. He gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls when using a weapon from this group. In addition, the bonuses granted by previous weapon groups increase by +1 each. For example, when a fighter reaches 9th level, he receives a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with one weapon group and a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls with the weapon group selected at 5th level. Bonuses granted from overlapping groups do not stack. Take the highest bonus granted for a weapon if it resides in two or more groups. A fighter also adds this bonus to any combat maneuver checks made with weapons from this group. This bonus also applies to the fighter's Combat Maneuver Defense when defending against disarm and sunder attempts made against weapons from this group. Weapon groups are defined as follows (GMs may add other weapons to these groups, or add entirely new groups): Note from Nethys : A consolidated list of fighter weapon groups is provided here

Tactician.battle insight (ex): At 15th level, as a swift action, a tactician can grant his Intelligence modifier as an insight bonus on the attack rolls made by a single ally within line of sight that can both see and hear the tactician. That ally gains the bonus until the end of the tactician's next turn. The tactician can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + his Intelligence modifier. This ability replaces armor training 4.
Tactician.bonus feats: A tactician may choose Skill Focus or any teamwork feat, in addition to combat feats, as bonus feats.
Tactician.cooperative combatant (ex): At 11th level, when a tactician uses the aid another special attack, he may affect one additional ally per point of Intelligence bonus. For each ally that a tactician aids, he can pick whether to grant that ally the +2 bonus on its next attack against the opponent or the +2 bonus to AC against the opponent's next attack on that ally, and can grant different allies different bonuses. This ability replaces armor training 3.
Tactician.source: Ultimate Combat pg. 47 While many fighters focus on the fundamentals of melee and ranged combat, there are those who are trained to view the bigger picture on the battlefield. These fighters use their training and tactical acumen to overcome challenges that would overwhelm mere brute strength and skill at arms.
Tactician.strategic training (ex): A tactician gains 4 skill points + a number of skill points equal to his Intelligence modifier at each level, instead of the normal 2 skill points + Intelligence modifier at each level. Furthermore, Diplomacy (Cha), Knowledge (geography) (Int), Knowledge (nobility) (Int), Linguistics (Int), and Sense Motive (Wis) are all class skills for the tactician. This ability replaces the bonus fighter combat feat gained at 1st level.
Tactician.tactical awareness (ex): At 2nd level, a tactician gains a +1 bonus on initiative checks. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels after 2nd level (to a maximum of +5 at 18th level). This ability replaces bravery.
Tactician.tactician (ex): At 5th level, a tactician gains this ability as the cavalier class feature. He may use this ability once per day at 5th level, plus one additional time for every five levels after 5th (to a maximum of four times at 20th level). If the tactician also has cavalier levels, these levels stack for determining the number of uses per day, and he can take the better progression. This ability replaces weapon training 1.
Tactician.weapon and armor proficiency: A tactician is not proficient with heavy armor or tower shields.

Shadow.description: This armor blurs the wearer whenever she tries to hide, while also dampening the sound around her, granting a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks. The armor's armor check penalty still applies normally.

conditionals.name: Ghost Touch: deals full damage to incorporeal creatures; can be wielded by them

Ghost Touch.description: A ghost touch weapon deals damage normally against incorporeal creatures, regardless of its bonus. An incorporeal creature's 50% reduction in damage from corporeal sources does not apply to attacks made against it with ghost touch weapons. The weapon can be picked up and moved by an incorporeal creature at any time. A manifesting ghost can wield the weapon against corporeal foes. Essentially, a ghost touch weapon counts as both corporeal or incorporeal. This special ability can only be placed on melee weapons and ammunition.

conditionals.name: Skewering: (light/one-handed piercing) on a critical threat, spend [[1]] panache as an immediate action to auto-confirm the crit (no panache regained for confirming)

Skewering.description: This special ability can be placed only on light or one-handed piercing melee weapons. Weapons with this enhancement are particularly devastating in the hands of a swashbuckler. Anytime the weapon threatens a critical hit, the wielder can spend 1 panache point as an immediate action to automatically confirm the critical hit. When the swashbuckler confirms a critical hit in this fashion, she doesn't regain panache for confirming the critical hit, though she can regain panache normally if the attack is a killing blow.

belts.description: this belt functions as a plague rat belt , except it grants the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to dexterity and constitution. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn.

body.description: this black corset fits neatly beneath armor. As a free action,  the wearer can compress herself to fit through tight spaces as though affected by a squeeze spell (advanced race guide) for up to 10 rounds per day. While using the corset's magic, she gains a +5 bonus on escape artist checks.

chest.description: this black linen tunic has simple brass buttons. Once per day, the wielder can attune the garment to one ally by standing for 1 minute in a position in which both the wielder's and his ally's shadows overlap. For the next 24 hours, whenever the wielder is adjacent to that ally and that ally takes damage, the wielder can sacrifice up to 10 hit points to prevent an equal amount of damage done to the ally. This damage cannot be reduced or redirected, and if the wielder is incapable of sacrificing hit points, the damage to the ally cannot be prevented. If the vest is removed before its duration ends, the connection between the wielder and ally is lost and the vest is powerless until 24 hours have passed since its last attunement.

eyes.description: these nondescript, brass-rimmed spectacles have green-tinted lenses and are favored by practicing doctors and adventurers alike. When worn, they grant the wearer a constant awareness of poisons and diseases as the detect poison and diagnose disease spells. Also, once per day on command the wearer can touch a single creature to use delay poison on that creature.

feet.description: this pair of magical softpaw boots (see above) allows the catfolk wearing them to gain extra maneuverability while moving through hazardous areas. As a free action, the wearer can click her heels together to grant herself a +5 competence bonus on acrobatics checks made to move through threatened squares or to move through an enemy's space without provoking attacks of opportunity for up to 10 rounds per day. The rounds need not be consecutive. Furthermore, anytime the wearer of the boots successfully moves though the space of an enemy without provoking an attack of opportunity, she gains a +2 bonus on attack rolls against that enemy until the end of her turn.

hands.description: these fine silk wrappings-covered in mystic symbols and diagrams of the wearer's pressure points-wind around the wearer's hands and wrists. When the wearer spends ki to make an additional attack, he can spend 1 additional point of ki to use the stunning fist feat with the attack, even if he has already used the feat that round. If the wearer is a monk using an archetype that replaces stunning fist with a different feat that's usable a number times per day equal to his monk level, hand wraps of blinding ki allow that feat to be used a second time instead of allowing him to use stunning fist.

head.description: the helm of electric radiance is similar to a helm of brilliance ,  except its spells focus on electricity rather than fire. Other aspects of the helm, such as detecting and damaging undead, remain unchanged. The helm has 10 sapphires that can be used for chain lightning , 20 pieces of amber that can be used for lightning bolt , 30 pieces of petrified wood that can be used for shocking sphere (as flaming sphere but dealing electricity damage), and 40 opals that can be used for daylight . In addition, the wearer gains resistance to electricity 30 and his weapons become shocking weapons instead of flaming weapons.

headband.description: this plain white band makes the wearer seem more attractive. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on charisma-based checks with other members of his creature type. If the wearer is of the humanoid type, he gains a +5 competence bonus on creatures of his subtype instead. Once per day, the wearer can attempt to affect a creature as the spell unnatural lust (ultimate magic) but with a duration of 10 minutes.

neck.description: a stormlure is usually fashioned from pieces of creatures known for their affinity to airthe feathers of birds, the shells of flying insects, and the scales of a dragon. When activated, stormlures call to the wind, causing a tempestuous gale. Once per day on command, the wearer of a stormlure is surrounding by swirling winds for 1 minute, granting a 50% miss chance against all ranged attacks, including rays and other ranged spells that require a roll to hit. This wind does not hinder the wearer of the stormlure in any way. At any one time during this duration, as a swift action, the wearer can cause the air around her to fill with crackling lightning,  dealing 4d6 points of electricity damage to all creatures adjacent to her. A dc 14 reflex save halves this damage.

rings.description: This gold ring resembles tiny angel wings folded around a clear crystal. Once per day, the wearer can target herself with a protection from chaos or protection from law effect that lasts for 10 minutes. However, if the wearer uses the ring of entropy and order to gain protection from chaos while on a plane with the mildly chaos-aligned or strongly chaos-aligned trait, or to gain protection from law while on a plane with the mildly law-aligned or strongly law-aligned trait, the effect instead lasts for 1 hour. If the wearer fails a saving throw against a charm or compulsion effect while on a plane with the mildly chaos-aligned, mildly law-aligned, strongly chaos-aligned, or strongly law-aligned traits, she can activate the effect as an immediate action.

shoulders.description: this silvery cape furls and ripples like a flag with every step its owner takes. As a swift action,  the wearer can order the cape to transform into a faint sphere of force that surrounds him on all sides. The field grants the wearer concealment (20% miss chance) against ranged attacks and lasts for 1 minute or until the wearer is missed by a ranged attack due to the power of the cloak, whichever comes first. When the field is used, all magic is lost from the cloak, leaving only a mundane silvery garment.

wrist.description: these translucent cloth tubes easily fit over their wearer's arms. The wearer of these sleeves can, when she slips them on, choose to transform the appearance of her current garments into any other nonmagical set of clothing. These new clothes fit her perfectly and are always clean and mended unless she specifically designates otherwise. When she removes the sleeves, her clothes revert to their original form.

Bloody Assault.name: Bloody Assault: Effect: melee attacks and combat maneuver checks also deal [[1d4]] bleed damage

Desperate Battler.name: Desperate Battler: When no ally is within 10 feet and you are not benefiting from aid another: +1 morale bonus on melee attack rolls and +1 morale bonus on melee damage rolls.

contextNotes.text: Motion Sickness: after [[10]] minutes riding/sailing, Fortitude save DC [[5]] or sickened while it continues.

Motion Sickness.description: Travel turns your stomach. After 10 minutes riding a mount, vehicle, or ship, you must pass a Fortitude save (DC 5) or be sickened for as long as the ride continues.

contextNotes.text: Powerless Prophecy: no actions in surprise rounds; without a surprise round, staggered for round [[1]].

Powerless Prophecy.description: You are forewarned of danger but cannot act to prevent it. You can take no actions during a surprise round (not even free actions), and if there is no surprise round you are staggered for the entire first round of combat.

formatted_bio:
Sébastien Dupuy
- Alignment: Lawful Good
- Deity: Erastil
- Race: Human
- Class: Level 16 Fighter
- Archetype: Man-at-Arms
- Tactics: Fights the way it drilled: hold the line, strike the enemy in front of you, keep your shield up and your footing. No tricks, no gimmick -- just a professional doing soldier's work.
- Stat Focus: Str
- Homeland: Tal-falko

Vocation
- Profession: Court Jester (rank 16)
- Profession: Raid Marauder (rank 11)
- Profession: Storm-Wise Helmsman (rank 8)
- Profession: Lookout Boy (rank 10)
- Known for: Pickling

Family
- Absent Mother
- Loving Father
- Raised In A Poor Household
- 2 Older Brothers

Personality
- Personality: Fervent, Rebellious, Selfish, Fearsome
- Mannerisms: Drums fingers, Yawns, Clenches fists
- Flaws: Motion Sickness, Powerless Prophecy

Appearance
- Hair: Frizzy Blond
- Eyes: Green
- Build: Spectacled

homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Always Improving: You can spend ordinary skill ranks in your chosen profession. (Requires True Calling and 15 ranks.)
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Animal Affinity: You are skilled at working with animals and mounts
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Arcane Vendetta: The mistreatment of your people by an arcane society (such as Numeria's Technic League or the White Witches of Irrisen) has made you particularly eager to inf lict harm on those who use arcane magic
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Ass Pull: Gain 4 E-Kats per session that expire upon the session's end, and a +4 Luck.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Bloody Assault: Sacrificing accuracy, you can inflict bloody wounds that are slow to heal
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Bull Charge (combat): You rush into battle with a devastating attack. Normal Charging causes you to take a -2 penalty to your AC until the start of your next turn. you take no penalty to your ac when you make a charge attack. if you have the vital strike feat, you can use vital strike (or improved vital strike or greater vital strike, if you have them) in place of the attack at the end of a charge. the damage dice added by vital strike, improved vital strike, or greater vital strike are not doubled when charging with a lance while mounted.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Dark Embrace: Shadows magically ward you, shielding you from harm. while in dim light, darkness, or supernatural darkness, you gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws. this is a supernatural effect.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Death Frombelow: You have been trained to fight flying creatures
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Desperate Battler: Your experiences fighting against numerous foes that have already overwhelmed your allies, friends, and family have forced you to excel at fighting on your own
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Enduring Mind: You are trained to resist mental damage. whenever you would suffer ability damage to a mental ability score, reduce that damage by 2 (to a minimum of 0). ability damage you deal to yourself (such as from one of your feats or powers) is not reduced in this fashion.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Ensemble: You can create an ensemble of skilled and amateur performers to aid you in your performance
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.It Just Works: Gain one free Hero Point per session that expires upon the session's end, +4 Luck.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Miniature Reach: No matter how small you are, you are always a threat. whenever you are under the effects of a polymorph effect which would reduce your size to tiny or smaller, your natural reach is always treated as 5 feet, regardless of your size.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Multi Talented: Your profession rank cap increases by 10.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Multi Talented (2nd): Your profession rank cap increases by 10. This is the 2nd time you have taken this feat.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Ostentatious Display: Your extravagant jewelry and accessories give you an air of importance you can use to your advantage in many social situations
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Powerful Throwing (combat): Your thrown weapons are as strong as they are accurate. Special Starting at 2nd level, a ranger with the thrown weaponACG combat style may select Powerful Throwing as a combat style feat. you can use your strength modifier for both your attack and damage rolls with thrown weapons.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Right of Deferment: You may wait to apply E-Kats after a roll for no penalty.
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Self-Sufficient: You know how to get along in the wild and how to effectively treat wounds
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Shadow Dodge: You use light and darkness to your advantage, confusing your enemies and confounding their senses
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Siege Commander: Under your leadership, the time required to assemble and move a siege engine is greatly reduced
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.Simple Weapon Proficiency: You are trained in the use of basic weapons
homebrew_feat_desc_dict.True Calling: Your natural Profession rank cap rises to 15 in one qualifying profession.

contextNotes.text: As a swift action, the wearer can order the cape to transform into a faint sphere of force that surrounds him on all sides. The field grants the wearer concealment (20% miss chance) against ranged attacks and lasts for [[1]] minute or until the wearer is missed by a ranged attack due to the power of the cloak, whichever comes first.

As a free action, the wearer can compress herself to fit through tight spaces as though affected by a squeeze spell (advanced race guide) for up to [[10]] rounds per day. While using the corset's magic, she gains a +[[5]] bonus on escape artist checks.

As a free action, the wearer can click her heels together to grant herself a +[[5]] competence bonus on acrobatics checks made to move through threatened squares or to move through an enemy's space without provoking attacks of opportunity for up to [[10]] rounds per day.

Furthermore, anytime the wearer of the boots successfully moves though the space of an enemy without provoking an attack of opportunity, she gains a +[[2]] bonus on attack rolls against that enemy until the end of her turn.
When the wearer spends ki to make an additional attack, he can spend 1 additional point of ki to use the stunning fist feat with the attack, even if he has already used the feat that round.

If the wearer is of the humanoid type, he gains a +[[5]] competence bonus on creatures of his subtype instead. Once per day, the wearer can attempt to affect a creature as the spell unnatural lust (ultimate magic) but with a duration of [[10]] minutes.

unplaced: The helm has 10 sapphires that can be used for chain lightning , 20 pieces of amber that can be used for lightning bolt , 30 pieces of petrified wood that can be used for shocking sphere (as flaming sphere but dealing electricity damage), and 40 opals that can be used for daylight . In addition, the wearer gains resistance to electricity 30 and his weapons become shocking weapons instead of flaming weapons.
Also, once per day on command the wearer can touch a single creature to use delay poison on that creature.

contextNotes.text: This belt functions as a plague rat belt , except it grants the wearer a +[[2]] enhancement bonus to dexterity and constitution. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first [[24]] hours the belt is worn.

unplaced: Once per day, the wearer can target herself with a protection from chaos or protection from law effect that lasts for 10 minutes. However, if the wearer uses the ring of entropy and order to gain protection from chaos while on a plane with the mildly chaos-aligned or strongly chaos-aligned trait, or to gain protection from law while on a plane with the mildly law-aligned or strongly law-aligned trait, the effect instead lasts for 1 hour.

Once per day, the wielder can attune the garment to one ally by standing for 1 minute in a position in which both the wielder's and his ally's shadows overlap. For the next 24 hours, whenever the wielder is adjacent to that ally and that ally takes damage, the wielder can sacrifice up to 10 hit points to prevent an equal amount of damage done to the ally. If the vest is removed before its duration ends, the connection between the wielder and ally is lost and the vest is powerless until 24 hours have passed since its last attunement.

contextNotes.text: Once per day on command, the wearer of a stormlure is surrounding by swirling winds for [[1]] minute, granting a 50% miss chance against all ranged attacks, including rays and other ranged spells that require a roll to hit. At any one time during this duration, as a swift action, the wearer can cause the air around her to fill with crackling lightning, dealing [[4d6]] points of electricity damage to all creatures adjacent to her. A dc [[14]] reflex save halves this damage.

profession_ability_items.description:
Profession (Court Jester) - rank 16/15. Associate skills (ranks 1/4/7/10): Profession, Perception, Sense Motive, Handle Animal.

Quick Curtsy (Ex)

A practiced bow or pirouette keeps you light on your feet under the stage lights. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks.

Crowd-Pleaser (Ex)

You have a knack for playing to whatever audience is in front of you. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Perform checks to entertain a crowd.
profession_ability_items.name: Profession Rank 5: (Court Jester)

contextNotes.text: +1 morale on attacks while you perform for them

profession_ability_items.description:
Profession (Court Jester) - rank 16/15.

Inspiring Refrain (Su)

When you raise your voice in song, your companions take heart. While you perform, allies who can hear you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls.

Fascinating Flourish (Sp)

With a hypnotic gesture and a lilting tune you can rivet a creature's attention. A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier, as a standard action you can target one creature within 30 feet that can see and hear you; unless it succeeds on a Will save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Charisma modifier) it is fascinated for as long as you continue a Perform action, up to 1 round per character level.

Heckler's Tongue (Ex)

Years of trading insults from the stage have honed your tongue to a razor. You gain a +3 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.
profession_ability_items.name: Profession Rank 15: (Court Jester)

contextNotes.text: +1 morale to attack and damage vs foes below half HP
+2 on saves vs fear, pain, and compulsion

profession_ability_items.description:
Profession (Raid Marauder) - rank 11/10. Associate skills (ranks 1/4/7/10): Profession, Knowledge (local), Handle Animal, Craft.

Savage Strike (Ex)

You strike to maim, not to win. You gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against any creature that is below half its maximum hit points.

Cruel Resolve (Ex)

Years of inflicting pain have left you numb to your own. You gain a +2 untyped bonus on saving throws against fear, pain, and compulsion effects, and you are never sickened by the sight of blood or suffering.
profession_ability_items.name: Profession Rank 5: (Raid Marauder)

contextNotes.text: +2 initiative in favored terrain
Ignores natural difficult terrain when moving

profession_ability_items.description:
Profession (Storm-Wise Helmsman) - rank 8/10. Associate skills (ranks 1/4/7/10): Knowledge (local), Handle Animal, Sleight of Hand.

Favored Terrain (Ex)

Choose one type of terrain. While in it you gain a +2 bonus on initiative and on Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks, and you leave no trail and cannot be tracked unless you choose.

Animal Companion (Ex)

You gain a loyal animal companion that advances as that of a druid of a level equal to half your character level (minimum 1).

Woodland Stride (Ex)

The character moves through undergrowth, thorns, and natural difficult terrain at full speed, leaving the brush undisturbed behind them.
profession_ability_items.name: Profession Rank 5: (Storm-Wise Helmsman)

profession_ability_items.description:
Profession (Lookout Boy) - rank 10/10. Associate skills (ranks 1/4/7/10): Profession, Perception, Handle Animal, Use Magic Device.

Light Fingers (Ex)

A lifetime of palming coins and lifting purses makes petty theft second nature. The Fighter gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Sleight of Hand checks.

Quick Study (Ex)

You pick up the tricks of any trade. You gain a +1 bonus on two skills associated with your profession, and you can attempt those skills untrained.
profession_ability_items.name: Profession Rank 5: (Lookout Boy)

selected_traits_desc.description: You gain a +1 trait bonus on checks with a single Perform skill (your choice), and all Perform skills are always class skills for you.
selected_traits_desc.name: Talented

selected_traits_desc.description: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Climb checks, and Climb becomes a class skill for you.
selected_traits_desc.name: Seasoned Climber

selected_traits_desc.description: You gain a +1 trait bonus on all attack rolls against foes that threaten your older sibling as well as one of the following: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Will saving throws or you gain a +1 trait bonus on all Fortitude saving throws. If you’re the younger sibling of a specific NPC (consult your GM), your quick reflexes give you a +1 trait bonus on all Reflex saving throws.
selected_traits_desc.name: Younger Sibling

selected_traits_desc.description: You gain a +1 trait bonus on all attack rolls against foes that threaten your savior as well as one of the following: You gain a +2 trait bonus whenever you use cure spells to heal damage or you gain a +1 trait bonus on Acrobatics checks and Acrobatics is always a class skill for you.
selected_traits_desc.name: Rescued

selected_traits_desc.description: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Intimidate checks, and Intimidate is always a class skill for you.
selected_traits_desc.name: Viking Blood

selected_traits_desc.description: You may select a race trait from your adoptive parents’ race.
selected_traits_desc.name: Adopted

selected_traits_desc.description: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Stealth checks, and Stealth is always a class skill for you.
selected_traits_desc.name: Uskwood Hunter

selected_traits_desc.description: Once per day, you can tinker with a broken object to allow anyone who uses it to ignore the penalties for its broken condition for 24 hours (this does not affect the object’s hit points). At the end of this time, it regains the broken condition (but you can use this trait on it over and over again).
selected_traits_desc.name: Isger Fixer

unlock.10: After conversing for 1 minute, you can read a creature's surface thoughts at a -20 penalty opposed by its Bluff (as detect thoughts).
unlock.15: You can read surface thoughts after 1 round, and when attacked may attempt an immediate-action Sense Motive check to gain a +2 insight bonus to AC against that foe.
unlock.20: You can read surface thoughts as a standard action, and a successful insight-bonus check negates the triggering attack.
unlock.5: If aware of an opponent before initiative, you can attempt a Sense Motive check as part of initiative to gain a scaling initiative bonus.

skill_unlock.unlock_html:
Sense Motive

5 Ranks: If aware of an opponent before initiative, you can attempt a Sense Motive check as part of initiative to gain a scaling initiative bonus.

10 Ranks: After conversing for 1 minute, you can read a creature's surface thoughts at a -20 penalty opposed by its Bluff (as detect thoughts).

15 Ranks: You can read surface thoughts after 1 round, and when attacked may attempt an immediate-action Sense Motive check to gain a +2 insight bonus to AC against that foe.

20 Ranks: You can read surface thoughts as a standard action, and a successful insight-bonus check negates the triggering attack.
